title: Shared laundry repair
brief:
You are a tenant writing to the building caretaker about the shared laundry room. The folding table’s right leg wobbles, and you first noticed it on Monday evening. The room is still open and has a second folding surface by the dryers. Ask whether the caretaker can look at the table during the next maintenance round and when residents might expect it back in use. You will be away through Friday, so request a reply by email. Use a neighborly tone.

Aim for 70 to 150 words. Return the complete original work directly in your answer. Do not sign or identify yourself. Do not use tools.

f47c60cad1e128ad.text:
Hi there,

On Monday evening, I first noticed that the right leg of the folding table in the shared laundry room wobbles. Could you take a look at it during your next maintenance round? The room is still open, and residents can use the second folding surface by the dryers in the meantime.

When you’ve had a chance to check the table, could you let me know when residents can expect it to be back in use? I’ll be away through Friday, so please reply by email.

Thanks for taking a look!
